Learning Unit 2: Science, Safety and Image Interpretation

Learning outcome: Explain how Scannex forms an image, how materials affect its appearance and how approved controls support radiation protection and reliable interpretation.

Welcome to Learning Unit 2. Watch the opening clip, then complete the eight activities covering material appearance, X-ray history, layered safety, image quality, the electromagnetic family, X-ray production, clear explanations and dose context. Each activity has a summary and a knowledge check. Read the unit recap and glossary before the final knowledge check. Select each labelled control, enlarge the images and play or stop narration as you choose. This course uses AI-generated narration.
